title: The course — GPT100 Miler official page
publisher: SingleTrack Events / Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler
claims: The race is a point-to-point 100 mile trail of 163 km with 7,700 m of ascent from Mt Zero Picnic Area to Dunkeld, passing 12 campsites and 11 aid stations, and is split into four sections each ending at a major aid station.

The official leg table gives: GAR Trailhead #1 at 15.5 km (leg 15.5 km, 600 m +-); Mt Difficult Rd #2 at 35.5 km (20 km, +1,100 m, -670 m); Halls Gap #3 at 49.5 km (14 km, +300 m, -770 m); Rosea Carpark #4 at 59.5 km (9.7 km, +650 m, -270 m); Borough Huts Camp #5 at 72 km (12.8 km, +440 m, -745 m); Mt William Carpark #6 at 86.6 km (14.6 km, +1,260 m, -610 m); Jimmy Creek Rd #7 at 106.7 km (20.1 km, +775 m, -1,400 m); Yarram Gap Rd #8 at 118.5 km (11.8 km, +580 m, -560 m); Griffin Fireline #9 at 130.7 km (12.2 km, +440 m, -490 m); Cassidys Gap Rd #10 at 142 km (11.3 km, +450 m, -370 m); Bainggug Carpark #11 at 152.8 km (10.8 km, +650 m, -730 m); Finish Dunkeld #12 at 163 km (10.2 km, +455 m, -485 m).

The official cumulative distances are internally inconsistent by 0.3 km at one point: 49.5 km plus the 9.7 km leg gives 59.2 km, but Rosea Carpark is listed at 59.5 km; 59.5 km plus 12.8 km gives 72.3 km, but Borough Huts is listed at 72 km.
The twelve leg ascents sum to 7,700 m; the descents listed for legs 2 to 12 sum to 7,100 m, and with the first leg's symmetrical 600 m the total descent is also 7,700 m.
The Strava course map embedded on the same page lists 161.9 km and 7,588 m of elevation gain.
The page describes the trail as purpose-built through Grampians National Park, with much of the route in remote wilderness and the four sections each finishing at a major aid station.
